mprCopyParameterValues.Description: Copy parameter values between elements or within one element
mprCopyParameterValues.FullDescription: Various copying options for configuring source and target elements. Composite value copying (from several parameters to one) is available. Element selection filters by categories and parameter values are provided, as well as value conversion between different parameter types
mprCopyParameterValues.full: Available in the full version of the plugin
mprCopyParameterValues.cn2: Copying from one element to several
mprCopyParameterValues.cn4: Copying from parent family to nested
mprCopyParameterValues.cn5: Copying from a group to its children
mprCopyParameterValues.h11: The sample element is used to populate the list of parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h13: The element from which the parameter values will be copied. Also used to populate the list of parameter names in the parameter copy rules setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h15: The sample host element is used to populate a list of source parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h17: The sample target element is used to populate the list of target parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h21: Selecting the type of copy rule
mprCopyParameterValues.h22: Add a parameters copy rule of type:
mprCopyParameterValues.h26: Try to convert values between different types of parameters
mprCopyParameterValues.h29: Elements within which the copying of parameter values will be performed according to the specified rules
mprCopyParameterValues.h30: Elements to which the parameter values will be copied from the source element according to the specified rules
mprCopyParameterValues.h32: Host elements, from which the parameter values will be taken for copying to child elements according to the specified rules
mprCopyParameterValues.h34: Child elements, into which the values from the parameters of the host elements will be copied according to the specified rules. In this group, pre-filtering of child elements is configured, and during the copying process, filtering will be performed by the element's belonging to the host
mprCopyParameterValues.h44: Parameter search option by name: "=" – full match of the parameter name. "≈" – parameter name must contain the specified value
mprCopyParameterValues.h45: Add parameter name from parameter list of sample element
mprCopyParameterValues.h54: Formula contains errors and cannot be calculated

mprCopyParameterValues.h60: The sample nested family is used to populate a list of source parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h62: Parent families, from which parameter values will be taken to be copied to nested elements according to specified rules
mprCopyParameterValues.h64: Optional filtering of nested families by categories and/or parameters. If no filters are specified, all nested families will be processed
mprCopyParameterValues.h66: Open the folder where the files of saved configurations are located. To exchange configurations, they must be placed in this folder
mprCopyParameterValues.h68: The sample group is used to populate a list of source parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h70: The sample child element is used to populate a list of source parameter names in the parameter copy rule setup
mprCopyParameterValues.h72: Groups, from which parameter values will be taken to be copied to child elements according to specified rules
mprCopyParameterValues.h74: Optional filtering of child elements by categories and/or parameters. If no filters are specified, all child elements will be processed
mprCopyParameterValues.h75: Rounding is used only when the value to be set is a number
mprCopyParameterValues.h76: Support for this plugin has been discontinued. We recommend switching to the "Parametrization" plugin, which allows you to perform all the tasks that this plugin does
mprCopyParameterValues.i1: The input fields before and after the names of the source parameters allow you to create a formula for the calculation.
mprCopyParameterValues.i2: To create a formula, you can use simple arithmetic operators such as "+", "-", "*", "/", parentheses, and mathematical functions:
mprCopyParameterValues.i4: Pow – taking a number to a specified power,
mprCopyParameterValues.i5: Sqrt – getting the square root of the number.
mprCopyParameterValues.i6: When using functions, the values to be processed must be in parentheses. For example, if you want to get an absolute value of a parameter, enter "Abs(" in the field before the parameter name and ")" in the field after the parameter name.
mprCopyParameterValues.i7: For a complete list of functions, see the help page.
